frozen_on: 2026-11-08, after run_development.py and before run_final_test.py was ever executed
target: same-date percentile rank of the 90-day return (next-session close to first close on/after +90 calendar days)
training_rows: weekly signal dates from 2010-01-04, only rows with label_end < fit date
refit_schedule: after the close of 2016-03-31, then at the first session of every quarter (expanding window)
data_screen: exclude candidates with a one-session move above +100% or below -50% in the previous 252 sessions
rationale: Ridge had the best development Sharpe ratio with every universe screen and size (0.82-0.92 vs 0.65-0.79 for gradient boosting). Momentum-only results above the benchmark were driven by data incidents (e.g. the LCI ticker re-mapping). Among clean configurations, top-1000 / 30 names had the highest development CAGR (14.7% vs 14.9% for the benchmark) with a Sharpe ratio (0.89) within noise of the best (0.92) and no price incidents.
